# Julien Larget-Piet: Technical Blog

An independent technical blog focused on systems programming, Linux, programming languages, software architecture, performance engineering, data processing, and the internals of modern computing. Articles combine practical experimentation with deeper explanations of the mechanisms underneath, covering topics such as operating systems, package managers, networking, parsers, databases, compilers, low-level programming, benchmarking, and software design.

Articles are published as HTML pages under /articles/[title-slug].html
